Dubuque Bank & Trust Co. cut its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.3% during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The firm owned 100,238 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 11,449 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 3.0% of Dubuque Bank & Trust Co.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest holding. Dubuque Bank & Trust Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $18,555,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Equitec Specialists LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 57.9% during the second quarter. Equitec Specialists LLC now owns 3,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $555,000 after purchasing an additional 1,100 shares during the period. Cornerstone Investment Partners LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 9.8% during the second quarter. Cornerstone Investment Partners LLC now owns 512,438 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $94,857,000 after purchasing an additional 45,912 shares during the period. Baillie Gifford & Co. raised its position in shares of Apple by 0.3% during the second quarter. Baillie Gifford & Co. now owns 123,141 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $22,795,000 after purchasing an additional 331 shares during the period. ELCO Management Co. LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 4.8% during the second quarter. ELCO Management Co. LLC now owns 15,885 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,940,000 after purchasing an additional 727 shares during the period. Finally, Baystate Wealth Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 2.0% during the second quarter. Baystate Wealth Management LLC now owns 18,250 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,429,000 after purchasing an additional 364 shares during the period. 58.58% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. A number of brokerages have recently weighed in on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and set a $205.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. UBS Group set a $250.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday. BMO Capital Markets upped their target price on Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Finally, Cleveland Research reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the company. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $221.63. Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $223.77 on Tuesday. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.30, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $150.24 and a 1 year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $1.67 EPS. On average, equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.
In other Apple news, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, October 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total value of $3,235,664.24. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at approximately $24,058,442.48. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213 in the last 90 days. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
